entry.title: A smart home gateway earns its place for three reasons, and none of them is range
entry.summary: Gateways are usually sold as coverage devices. The box promises to extend reach, blanket the property, and remove dead zones, which is a compelling pitch and mostly irrelevant to why the device is useful. A gateway is not a range extender, and treating it as one leads to buying it at the wrong moment and expecting the wrong result. What it actually does is quieter and more structural: it decides where decisions get made. If your problem is that a camera at the far end of the property drops off the network, a gateway will not fix it. That is a radio problem between one device and one access point, and the fix is an access point, a better antenna, or a closer mounting position. Adding a gateway introduces a second network for some devices and leaves the original weak link exactly as weak as …

entry.title: App Attest and Play Integrity won't catch a real phone behind a proxy
entry.summary: App Attest and Play Integrity answer one question: is this my genuine app on a genuine device? That's worth knowing, and you should use them. But a real, unmodified app on a real phone passes, whether that phone is on a home connection or behind a proxy in a rack of phones. So if you're fighting fake signups, bonus farming or account takeover, you need a second question: what network is this request coming from? You can look for a VPN from inside the app. On Android, NetworkCapabilities.hasTransport(TRANSPORT_VPN) tells you about a VPN on the device. It's fine for showing a message, but it won't help against fraud, for two reasons: The app is reporting on itself. A modified client can answer whatever it likes. It can't see a proxy further upstream. The check belongs on a server, which sees…

entry.title: How to export multiple Confluence pages to Word
entry.summary: Short answer. Confluence Cloud has no built-in way to put several pages into one Word document. The Word export on a page exports that page only, and the space export offers PDF, HTML, XML and CSV but not Word. The free route is to export the pages you need into one PDF (the space PDF export lets you pick them) and open that PDF in Word. If the document has to look right or is produced regularly, use an app that exports a page tree straight to Word.
